backend/main.mo: Empty Motoko actor with no logic.
feature_evidence.json: Metadata listing feature requirements, affected files, and test IDs for layout, caption, image handling, and stage‑flow changes.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Prewritten summaries of all frontend files describing their purpose and behavior.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind base and theme variable definitions controlling colors, typography, and global styling.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point loading fonts, disabling cache, and mounting the React app.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main React app coordinating envelope, images, romantic lines, and final stage with guarded one-time progression.
frontend/src/components/EnvelopeEntry.ts: Envelope component with safe image loading, open animation, and click/keyboard handling.
frontend/src/components/FinalNote.tsx: Static final romantic message displayed in the final stage.
Footer component showing the closing signature text.
Lip‑biting image component with safe loading, timed or static modes, and caption reveal.
frontend/src/components/PetalField.tsx: Generates floating animated SVG petals with randomized movement.
frontend/src/components/RoseReveal.tsx: Reveals the rose image using safe image loading and a simple show animation.
frontend/src/components/TimedRomanticLin: Shows three romantic lines sequentially with timed visibility and triggers onComplete after the final line appears.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and manages a backend actor tied to the user’s Internet Identity and refreshes dependent queries on identity change.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides Internet Identity context including login, logout, stored identity loading, and status management using AuthClient.
frontend/src/hooks/useSafeImage.ts: Exposes loaded/error state and handlers for safely tracking image load success or failure.
frontend/src/index.css: Defines Tailwind base styles, theme variables, dark mode colors, custom fonts, and cinematic background and layout styling.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Bootstraps the React app with QueryClient and InternetIdentityProvider and mounts it to the root element.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Configures Tailwind with custom fonts, colors mapped to CSS variables, animations, and plugins.
project_state.json: Describes project version, requirements, known issues, and design rules for the cinematic Rose Day experience.
